prompt: A huge, heavy armored soldier stands with his feet planted wide apart. He slowly raises his right arm straight forward at shoulder height as if aiming a heavy cannon built into his forearm, and his left hand grabs his right forearm to brace it. He sinks his weight and leans into the shot, then fires one powerful blast: the right arm and shoulders kick up and back with heavy recoil and his torso rocks back onto the rear leg. Then he slowly lowers the arm and settles back into a heavy ready stance. His feet stay planted the whole time, no stepping, no walking.
